name: capacitor-plugin-spm-support
description: Adds Swift Package Manager support to an existing Capacitor plugin repository so apps using CapApp-SPM can consume it after CocoaPods Trunk goes read-only (expected December 2, 2026). Covers root Package.swift naming rules the Capacitor CLI depends on, CAPBridgedPlugin conversion (identifier, jsName, pluginMethods), removing the ObjC CAP_PLUGIN bridge (.m/.h), Sources/Tests layout, podspec and package.json files updates, third-party pod to SPM dependency mapping, resources/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy,
author: Cap-go
